verdict.rationale: vLLM's own GitHub README and homepage document installation through standard Python package managers: uv (recommended) or pip, with a one-line `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend auto` command. An official Docker Hub image is also offered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that installation is quick in practice, and in-depth install docs covering hardware- or platform-specific requirements.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
